metadata.description: Curated external reference dataset for Long-EZ Model 61. Aircraft specs are audited: only entries with status confirmed (cited to the registry) or derived (with a formula) count as truth; unverified entries are kept for history and are not graded.
metadata.datum_note: All fuselage stations (FS) in this file use the published datum, F.S. 0.0 (om-1980:p25). Code stations use the published datum directly (datum_offset_in = 0).

wing_area_sqft.notes: Wing area excludes the canard; the manual's total is 94.8 sq ft.

canard_area_sqft.notes: Canard area for the GU canard.

aspect_ratio.notes: Computed from the confirmed wing span and wing area.

max_gross_weight_lb.notes: Maximum takeoff gross weight. The manual also has a 1425 lb takeoff-only band (om-1980:p28).

useful_load_lb.notes: Computed from confirmed max gross and empty weight.

cg_range_fwd_fs.notes: Forward CG limit from the manual's chart, published datum.

cg_range_aft_fs.notes: Aft CG limit from the manual's chart, published datum.

neutral_point_fs.why: not found in CP-29/CP-31 or the manual; see docs/block1-source-notes.md
neutral_point_fs.notes: Value kept for history only; not found in the sources.

stall_speed_ktas.why: not found in CP-29/CP-31 or the manual; see docs/block1-source-notes.md
stall_speed_ktas.notes: Value kept for history only; not found in the sources.

range_nm.why: not found in CP-29/CP-31 or the manual; see docs/block1-source-notes.md
range_nm.notes: Value kept for history only; not found in the sources.

vne_ktas.notes: Red line speed 190 knots. Indicated: the builder placards the airspeed indicator with it (om-1980:p43). The key keeps its historical _ktas name; the units field is the basis (ledger row 76).

static_margin_pct.was_cited: raf-cp29:Derived from NP and CG aft limit
static_margin_pct.why: not found in CP-29/CP-31 or the manual; see docs/block1-source-notes.md
static_margin_pct.notes: Value kept for history only; derives from the unverified neutral point.

roncz_r1145ms.description: Roncz R1145MS — Long-EZ canard replacement airfoil (SAFETY CRITICAL)

cl_max.why: not found in the CP text, cobelu, plans OCR, or the public web (UIUC holds coordinates only); see docs/block1-source-notes.md
cl_max.notes: Maximum lift coefficient at design Reynolds number. The R1145MS maintains CLmax even with rain-induced surface roughness — key design requirement over GU25-5(11)8.

cm_zero.why: not found in the CP text, cobelu, plans OCR, or the public web (UIUC holds coordinates only); see docs/block1-source-notes.md
cm_zero.notes: Zero-lift pitching moment coefficient. Negative value indicates nose-down tendency at zero lift. Canard configuration uses this for stability — canard must carry positive load.

alpha_zero_lift_deg.why: not found in the CP text, cobelu, plans OCR, or the public web (UIUC holds coordinates only); see docs/block1-source-notes.md
alpha_zero_lift_deg.notes: Zero-lift angle of attack. Matches config.aero_limits.canard_alpha_0L = -3.0.

cd_min.why: not found in the CP text, cobelu, plans OCR, or the public web (UIUC holds coordinates only); see docs/block1-source-notes.md
cd_min.notes: Minimum profile drag coefficient at design Re. Used for section drag polar construction.

eppler_1230.description: Eppler 1230 (Modified) — Long-EZ main wing airfoil with trailing-edge reflex

was_cited.facility: Stuttgart Wind Tunnel / UIUC database compilation

cl_max.why: not found in the CP text, cobelu, plans OCR, or the public web (UIUC holds coordinates only); see docs/block1-source-notes.md
cl_max.notes: CLmax for base Eppler 1230. Long-EZ modification adds trailing-edge reflex (2.5%) which slightly reduces CLmax but improves pitch stability. config.aero_limits.wing_clmax = 1.45.

was_cited.facility: Stuttgart Wind Tunnel / UIUC database compilation

cm_zero.why: not found in the CP text, cobelu, plans OCR, or the public web (UIUC holds coordinates only); see docs/block1-source-notes.md
cm_zero.notes: Zero-lift pitching moment. The reflex modification in the Long-EZ version reduces nose-down tendency, contributing to longitudinal trim without requiring large canard download.

was_cited.facility: Stuttgart Wind Tunnel / UIUC database compilation

alpha_zero_lift_deg.why: not found in the CP text, cobelu, plans OCR, or the public web (UIUC holds coordinates only); see docs/block1-source-notes.md
alpha_zero_lift_deg.notes: Zero-lift angle of attack for base Eppler 1230. Matches config.aero_limits.wing_alpha_0L = -2.0.

was_cited.facility: Stuttgart Wind Tunnel / UIUC database compilation

cd_min.why: not found in the CP text, cobelu, plans OCR, or the public web (UIUC holds coordinates only); see docs/block1-source-notes.md
cd_min.notes: Minimum profile drag coefficient. Lower than R1145MS due to wing operating at lower lift coefficient in cruise.
